trigger.note: no round-level trigger pid. NormalCollectionSpin (ST140) is the PAID base reel spin (CostCredits=1000) carrying a CollectCount metronome (+1/spin, resets every 1000) plus a cosmetic CreditsSymbols coin-denomination string; SymbolIndexToRewards is present but EMPTY ({}) on 100% of records (no live collect-coin channel). UntilLoseRespin (ST72) is a win-driven server-side FREE respin (CostCredits=0 on 100%, ReMarks empty) that extends the triggering paid spin (ST140) and chains spin-after-spin (preceded by ST140 first-respin or ST72 chained) until a losing respin ends the burst. Both STs win via a NATIVE PayoutIdToWinAmount on a normal PayoutByPayline (no synth needed). ReelSkin 11x/21x are wild-rich boost-reel states pooled into the respin/base multiplier distributions. BuffCollectionMap is an empty per-cycle FeatureWin marker (win=0), not a settling SpinType.

validation.evidence: W1 (fleet batch onboard, 2026-06-18, chunk_0002 8 robots / 41,291 records): provenance clean (_cache_version:3, config c85d8ee7 / code de24775a, single md5 bucket). 2 STs. ST140 = PAID base spin (CostCredits=1000, full reel signature; CollectCount metronome 1..1000 resetting; CreditsSymbols constant cosmetic '100:1000 | '; SymbolIndexToRewards EMPTY {} on 40,000/40,000 -> NO live collect-coin channel; win 100% payid-attributed: WinCredits>0 count 5012 == nonzero-payid 5012) -> paid_spin/NormalCollectionSpin, field-signature-matches the validated M279 ST140 NormalCollectionSpin -> STRICT-REUSE the generic per-ST plugins (no new code). ST72 = FREE respin (CostCredits=0 on 100%, ReMarks empty, full reel signature incl native PayoutIdToWinAmount on every win: win_with_pid 873 / win_no_pid 0) preceded by ST140 (418, first respin) or ST72 (873, chained) -> it EXTENDS a paid spin, the respin pattern; role/play DERIVED from M269's OWN data + server FeatureWin key 'UntilLoseRespin' -> respin/UntilLoseRespin, field-signature-matches the validated respin STs (M43 ST50 WinRespin / M279 ST36 MoveSpin / M190 ST72) -> STRICT-REUSE respin_dynamics via the generic respin ROLE hook (no new plugin, no machine_spec edit, no new frontend dimension). ECONOMY INVARIANT EXACT: per-ST sum(WinCredits) == server FeatureWin (NormalCollectionSpin 20,778,000 == 20,778,000; UntilLoseRespin 16,075,000 == 16,075,000); BuffCollectionMap server win = 0 (empty marker). No novel mechanic: no _unattributed_residual (both STs carry native payids), no additive no-payid collect win, no settle-chain. CurJackpotStoreWin = 0 on 41,291/41,291 records (fleet-wide test-interface-zeroed).

Its CONTRIBUTION is captured (pooled into each ST's multiplier distribution + the multiplier_profile fat tail). Framework-team item IF a labeled boost-reel metric is wanted. (Pattern note matches M279/M190 skin-11: in-engine pure-random rare-boost state, fully testspin-observed, NOT out-of-engine.)

ST140 CollectCount metronome (1..1000, resets) carries no settling Wheel ST in M269's data (unlike M279 ST2) - the collect cycle is a cosmetic display counter here, not a wheel-firing trigger; SymbolIndexToRewards empty confirms no live-collect channel. collect_mechanic cosmetic estimated_correction_pp is value-agnostic.

out_of_engine_mechanics.name: CurJackpotStoreWin progressive (test-interface-zeroed)
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' is present on every ST140/ST72 round but =0 on 100% of in-sample records (41,291/41,291). FLEET-WIDE test-interface behavior (user-confirmed 2026-06-12, M275 gate 8): it IS a real progressive jackpot store, but the CURRENT testspin interface forces its accumulation to 0 (so the sample correctly shows 0). Parse as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST140/ST72 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE - when the interface is later optimized to populate it, the existing parser picks it up unchanged. The data RTP is the BASE RTP (excludes the progressive); the progressive ADDS on top once enabled.
